name: ctxroute
description: Declarative context routing for coding agents: a small, non-Turing-complete language that delivers knowledge (invariants, pitfalls, project skills) into an agent context at the exact tool call where it matters. Predictable, explainable, harness-agnostic.

scripts.test:fast: vitest run lib-pure.test.js sources-file.test.js frontmatter.test.js lint.test.js gate.test.js lib-pure.property.test.js frontmatter.property.test.js lock.test.js config-gate.test.js mutation-workflow-gate.test.js deadline.test.js deadline-gate.test.js
scripts.test:unit: vitest run lib-pure.test.js sources-file.test.js frontmatter.test.js lint.test.js gate.test.js
scripts.check:coupling: npm run check:deps && npm run check:duplication
scripts.check:all: npm run test:all && npm run check:types && npm run check:coupling && npm run test:mutation
scripts.test:deadline: vitest run deadline.test.js deadline-gate.test.js && vitest run --config vitest.heavy.config.mjs deadline-load.test.js
scripts.test:fleet: vitest run --config vitest.heavy.config.mjs hooks-fleet-gate.test.js deadline-vendor.test.js vendor-deadline.test.js
